The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Menugg]] lived in a '''village''' on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While there, he made a name for himself as a powerful soldier with many victories under his belt and a record of great success with [[Gender/Legends|women]]. His reputation eventually drew the attention of several off-worlders, who traveled to the village and persuaded Menugg to leave Gamorr and work for them by showing him items and images from elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="UA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Menugg's village was mentioned but not named in his entry in the [[2004]] ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]'', a supplemental book for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.
